result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position: any commitment is limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, and reconciled through a true-up rather than a penalty or take-or-pay charge. It also appropriately preserves Section 9.4 termination rights and leaves unrelated provisions unchanged. Drafting is professional, though “true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered” could be slightly clearer about the mechanics and effect of reducing the commitment.
